name: Can custom staircases be installed in existing homes?

mainEntity.name: Can custom staircases be installed in existing homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, custom staircases can be installed in existing homes, though the feasibility and complexity depend on the current structural layout. For example, replacing an existing staircase might involve minimal structural changes, while adding a new staircase in a previously empty space could require significant modifications to floor joists or load-bearing walls. Hometelligent Inc. conducts an on-site assessment to determine the best approach, evaluate structural requirements, and advise on any necessary preparations or modifications to integrate the new staircase safely and effectively into your home's current structure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom staircases can be installed in existing homes, but feasibility depends on structural layout and may require modifications.
